Students of BCA (Hons) - II are to constructively engage themselves in
Summer Internship Project (SIP) as part of the curriculum at the end of
The SIP is to be carried out by applying theoretical concepts, tools &
techniques on a real information system
SIP should be completed during summer breaks
On completion of SIP students are required to prepare a brief report in soft
Duration of the SIP would be Four - Six weeks
Report submission would be in the first week of commencement of IIIrd
The SIP should include the usage of either of HTML, Database
Internal committee shall be comprised to evaluate the SIP
Project should be of 50 marks, divided into 2 parts :
Total Credits for the paper are 3
Student should incorporate following features based on technology
a. Programming in C - Arrays, Structure / union, file handling , pointers
b. HTML - various tags from forms and inputs, formatting, frames
images, audio/video, links, lists, tables, styles and semantics
